description: This file defines the CommentsController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling HTTP requests related to comments on articles such as creating, listing, and deleting comments.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller class managing comment-related HTTP endpoints, using MediatR for command/query dispatching.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by id from an article identified by slug.
